data.title: Accident questionnaire from liability insurer
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG wrote on 6 May 2026 about the car accident of 28 April 2026, in which the other party has made claims. You must return a completed questionnaire on how the accident happened within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made claims against your motor liability insurance (Kfz-Haftpflicht). To clarify who is at fault, the insurer needs your account of what happened. Fill in the questionnaire and send it back within 10 working days (Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays) of the letter date. The app shows the deadline. The questionnaire itself was not included in the text provided, so check that you received it. If fault or the claim is significant, consider getting professional advice.
